Product Features

  • Introducing you to the epitome of modern elegance: our stunning white TV stand with a luxurious grey marble look (no marble material, only the surface of the grain resembles marble). Designed with style and functionality in mind, this exquisite piece of furniture is the perfect addition to your entertainment space.
  • With an impressive width of 180 cm, this TV stand offers enough space for TVs up to 80 inches, making it an eye-catcher in your living room. The white finish exudes elegance and modern charm, while the subtle grey marble look adds a touch of timeless beauty and blends seamlessly into various interior styles.
  • A special feature is the glass shelf, which is skilfully integrated into the design. The transparent glass shelf is not only a visually appealing element, but also serves as a practical storage solution. It is the ideal place to display your valuable collectibles, family heirlooms or multimedia devices, creating an aesthetically pleasing arrangement.
  • With its clean lines, the TV stand exudes minimalism and gives your space a generous sense of space. The combination of glossy white and grey marble look gives a sense of luxury and sophistication, making this piece of furniture an eye-catcher that suits a variety of interior styles – from modern to seamless to minimalist.
  • Create a fascinating entertainment area full of elegance and style with our TV stand. Its generous width, white finish and refined grey marble look, coupled with the functional glass shelf, make it a stunning addition to your home and make your entertainment area a place where beauty and functionality meet in perfect harmony.
  • 【TV Stand with RGB Lighting】 Our modern LED TV stand perfectly matches any interior style, and is great for living rooms, bedrooms, and offices. Choose from hundreds of colors to customize your atmosphere – ideal for birthdays, game nights, family gatherings, parties, or other special occasions.
  • [Spacious Storage] The TV stand has two drawers, four cabinets, and three open shelves that can accommodate TVs up to 80 inches. The glass shelves provide the best presentation for your collection.
  • 【Easy Assembly & Excellent Service】 This bedroom shelf comes with step-by-step instructions and all accessories. Accessories and all parts are neatly arranged and labeled so you can find them quickly. If you encounter any problems during assembly, please contact us at any time.
  • Modern TV stand for 80 inch TVs: 180*40*45 cm (L x W x H). Suitable for TVs from 40 to 80 inches, 50 kg load capacity. The white finish combines a matte finish with sturdy chipboard, providing a stylish, tall TV stand for living rooms and bedrooms.
  • Delivery: The table is delivered in 2 boxes. We ship the same day, but the carrier can deliver on different days. Therefore, make sure that you do not assemble the table until you receive all the packages.
